findings.desc: The Lab opened an unauthenticated browser candidateReview URL even though the feed review lookup requires Telegram Mini App authentication.
The first denied or incompatible READY release could starve later READY releases that were still eligible for approval progress.
The candidate review availability gate ran before the already-decided idempotent approval replay path.
A delayed PREPARING projection for the same release could overwrite READY_FOR_APPROVAL and erase its binding and notification state.
Release preparation and source-agent git fetch/worktree operations did not share one repository lane and could contend on refs and worktree metadata.
The singleton publication proof exercised only the generic mutex instead of two real service publication attempts.
A locally synthesized READY outcome_unknown receipt was not distinguishable from a durable backend receipt and exposed no retry action.
